+        # all chunks of text are encoded separately, then results are joined
+        # chunks repeat a lot in natural text (" the", ","): encode each distinct
+        # chunk not cached yet once (cache: chunk -> ids, shared by the caller);

+        encode_chunk = self._encode_chunk
+        for chunk in set(text_chunks).difference(cache):
+            cache[chunk] = encode_chunk(chunk.encode("utf-8"), inf)
+        # join the per-chunk ids in text order (in C)
+        return list(chain.from_iterable(map(cache.__getitem__, text_chunks)))

actions.diff:
--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -285,9 +285,13 @@
-        # all chunks of text are encoded separately, then results are joined
-        # chunks repeat a lot in natural text (" the", ","): encode each distinct
-        # chunk not cached yet once (cache: chunk -> ids, shared by the caller);
-        # chunks merge independently, so the encoding order does not matter
-        encode_chunk = self._encode_chunk
-        for chunk in set(text_chunks).difference(cache):
-            cache[chunk] = encode_chunk(chunk.encode("utf-8"), inf)
-        # join the per-chunk ids in text order (in C)
-        return list(chain.from_iterable(map(cache.__getitem__, text_chunks)))
+        # all chunks of text are encoded separately, then results are joined
+        ids = []
+        # chunks repeat a lot in natural text (" the", ","): encode each distinct
+        # chunk once per call (cache: chunk -> ids, shared by the caller)
+        cache_get = cache.get
+        encode_chunk = self._encode_chunk
+        for chunk in text_chunks:
+            chunk_ids = cache_get(chunk)
+            if chunk_ids is None:
+                chunk_bytes = chunk.encode("utf-8") # raw bytes
+                chunk_ids = cache[chunk] = encode_chunk(chunk_bytes, inf)
+            ids.extend(chunk_ids)
+        return ids

--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -14,2 +14,2 @@
-from itertools import chain
-
+from itertools import repeat
+

--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -74,4 +74,8 @@
-        where = defaultdict(set)
-        for k, chunk_ids in enumerate(ids):
-            for p in zip(chunk_ids, chunk_ids[1:]):
-                where[p].add(k)
+        where = defaultdict(set)
+        where_get = where.__getitem__
+        set_add = set.add
+        for k, chunk_ids in enumerate(ids):
+            # where[p].add(k) for every pair p of the chunk, all in C
+            # (exhausted by a zero-length deque)
+            exhaust(map(set_add, map(where_get, zip(chunk_ids, chunk_ids[1:])),
+                        repeat(k)), 0)

--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -12,2 +12,3 @@
-from collections import defaultdict
-
+from collections import defaultdict
+from collections import deque as exhaust
+
